purpose: Map Refinery competitive-feedback decisions into bounded Gauntlet actions while consuming Hardware-Splicer's canonical operating posture instead of redefining project scope independently.

project_state_contract.note: Hardware-Splicer owns product identity, investment posture, and authority boundaries. Gauntlet owns route allocation and conversion priority within that contract.

IMPROVE_HS_SHELL.note: Presentation-layer improvements may proceed when the observation is source-bound and HS-native.

IMPROVE_HS_WORKFLOW.note: Use existing evidence/authority semantics; do not invent a parallel truth model.

INTEGRATE_NOT_REBUILD.note: Prefer adapters, protocols, import/export, deep links or artifact views over cloning source-tool capability.

RESEARCH_GATE.note: No implementation authorization. Reproduce a concrete HS gap or gather evaluator/physical evidence first.

INVESTIGATE_CORE_CHANGE.note: Investigation is allowed; core mutation remains unauthorized until root cause, successor design and invalidation plan are reviewed.

HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE.note: Competitor concept alone does not reopen HS.

OBSERVE.note: No source-bound evidence is sufficient for engineering.

OBSERVE_OR_ROUTE_ELSEWHERE.note: Compare portfolio assets for the opportunity; do not delete or degrade the corresponding HS capability.

project_guardrails: Hardware-Splicer remains a first-class flagship technical asset under its canonical operating state.
A route moving to another portfolio asset is not evidence that HS should lose a capability.
A competitor capability is not evidence that HS should clone that capability.
A competitor can justify targeted HS improvement when the gap is source-bound, HS-native and within the classifier's allowed scope.
Only exact-subject HS defects, physical failures or evaluator findings may begin a truth-model investigation.
No competitive-feedback decision automatically authorizes a core semantics mutation.

priority_override.name: Physical proof campaign: fabricate, bring up, and bind SPI evidence
priority_override.rule: Generic competitor-driven work must not displace the physical-proof campaign unless the new finding blocks that campaign or exposes a concrete safety or exact-subject HS defect.

reopen_when: rendered usability review exposes a concrete deficiency
a user or evaluator cannot complete an HS-native workflow
a source-bound competitor delta exposes a specific HS-native gap
